en-US.title: Venture: History Nearby
en-US.subtitle: History hiding around you
en-US.promoText: Step outside and uncover the ships, statues, plaques and hidden histories around you. Venture turns an ordinary walk into a journey through the past.
en-US.description:
What happened here?

Venture turns an ordinary walk into a journey through the past. Open the app and discover the ships, palaces, statues, plaques, buildings and vanished places hiding all around you.

DISCOVER WHAT OTHERS WALK PAST
See nearby history ordered by walking distance, with photographs that make each discovery instantly recognisable.

WALK INTO THE STORY
Choose something that catches your eye and follow a real walking route straight to it, complete with distance, time and turn-by-turn guidance.

LET THE PLACE COME ALIVE
Read or listen to concise, engaging tellings. Explore visual timelines and historical photographs, then go deeper whenever curiosity takes hold.

TRUST THE SOURCE
Every story keeps you connected to its credited source. Continue into the original article for the full history and follow photo credits back to their creators.

EXPLORE ANYWHERE
Search another place to explore before a day out or discover somewhere new without sharing your location. No account is required.

Venture draws on credited historical and geographic sources including Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, Historic England, Open Plaques and Geograph. Coverage varies by area. Always check walking directions against signs and current local conditions.
